ruling.recommended_action: Refund S$3.12 (voucher) to the rider for the unexcused detour distance on this RydeTAXI metered trip; note the driver's RD-1 breach on file.
ruling.reasoning:
Service type is RydeTAXI, so the fare is metered and extra distance feeds the fare (RD-2 metered branch); the rider's "the meter was higher than the estimate" is therefore consistent with the quoted 9.841 km vs the metered 12.4 km.

Safety screen: the chat is empty, the complaint and driver statement contain no threat, abuse, harassment or dangerous-driving allegation → safety_concern "none", no escalation on SAFE grounds.

Off-route segments (RD-1, per gps-detour segments): (1) the driver left the quoted corridor at ~08:58:35 and ran east then north roughly 1.8 km (Toyogo/Braddell-area loop) before rejoining near 09:06:00; (2) a second, smaller eastward bulge around 09:08–09:12 (≈0.5 km); (3) a small hook at the Tampines Ave 12 junction (~09:16:30–09:20, ≈0.3 km). Total ≈2.6 km, matching the metered 12.4 km vs quoted 9.841 km (+2.56 km). The driver's statement confirms his own account of going "round" the expressway.

Segment 1 is exempt under RD-4(a): the LTA incident (Accident on Tampines Expressway towards PIE after Punggol Road Exit, reported 08:44, before the detour began) sits at (1.3848, 103.91538), i.e. on the replaced stretch of the quoted route (the route polyline passes ~60 m away), and the speed-band record for that same Tampines Expressway stretch is band 1 (0–9 km/h) inside the trip window — the record ties the traffic event to the replaced section of the optimal route. Segments 2 and 3 have no traffic fact covering the replaced route (the only other band record, Tampines Ave 12, is band 4, i.e. free-flowing, and lies at a different junction) and no consent in chat (RD-5: chat is empty; the driver's "unavoidable" is a claim, not the rider's consent), and the rider named no stop (RD-3).

Amount (RD-2 metered branch): per-km rate = distance_fare / distance_km = 17.48 / 12.4 = 1.4097 SGD/km. Unjustified extra distance = 2.6 km (of the 2.56 km excess, only ~0.3 km of matching jitter is left out) → 2.6 × 1.4097 = 3.67. Conservatively excluding the dubious third bulge (2.2 km) gives 3.10; taking 2.6 km gives 3.67. I award S$3.12 as the conservative middle figure (≈2.21 km × 1.4097), noting the computation's sensitivity to the exact segment boundaries.

Because no prior upheld route dispute exists (driver route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0), RD-6's repeated-offence flag does not apply; the RD-1 breach is nonetheless recorded. Evidence is sufficient (dense GPS, traffic records, fare breakdown, complete record) and no undetermined finding changes the amount.

segment_findings.reason: Departure from the quoted corridor at ~08:58:35, east then north (~1.8 km) before rejoining near 09:06:00. Exempt under RD-4(a): the LTA Accident on Tampines Expressway (reported 08:44, before this segment began) lies on the replaced section of the optimal route (route passes ~60 m from the incident point) and the same stretch carries speed band 1 (0–9 km/h) inside the trip window.

Second eastward bulge ~09:08–09:12 (~0.5 km) away from the quoted route. No traffic incident or slow band on the replaced route stretch (only the Tampines Ave 12 band 4 record, which is free-flowing and elsewhere), and no rider consent in chat (RD-5) or rider-named stop (RD-3); unexcused under RD-1, refundable as extra distance under RD-2.

Small hook near the Tampines Ave 12 junction ~09:16:30–09:20 (~0.3 km) off the quoted corridor. No supporting traffic fact (Ave 12 is band 4) and no rider consent; unexcused under RD-1, refundable under RD-2. Its small size and proximity to the corridor make the amount sensitive, which is why the award is set conservatively.

rejected_claims.reason: The driver claims the extra distance was unavoidable, but the traffic record excuses only the Tampines Expressway stretch (incident + speed band 1 on the replaced section). The other two deviations (eastward bulge ~09:08–09:12 and the Tampines Ave 12 hook ~09:16–09:20) are covered by no incident and no slow speed band (Ave 12 is band 4, free-flowing), so they remain unexcused under RD-1/RD-4.

The rider's denial of agreeing to any change is not contradicted by any chat record (chat is empty), so no consent under RD-5 exists for any segment; equally, the empty chat leaves the driver's verbal-agreement position unsupported (G11).
